experience.title: AI Engineer
bullets: Implemented Protobuf serialization over persistent WebSocket connections to async FastAPI ingestion services, including reconnection and client-side buffering to handle unreliable connections.

Implemented bounded Redis Streams with consumer workers and backoff signaling, helping the real-time ingestion pipeline absorb bursty traffic, sustaining up to 1,200 events/sec into PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB without data loss.
Worked on Redis queue + worker-pool decoupling of ingestion from database writes, with timestamp/sequence-based event reordering to handle out-of-order data.

Built an anomaly-triggered RAG diagnostic pipeline using embeddings, retrieval, LangChain, and historical timeseries context to generate evidence-grounded diagnostic reports, reducing manual investigation time by 25%.
Implemented automated RAGAS + DeepEval evaluation against synthetic ground truth, improving context precision by ~5% and faithfulness by 12%.

experience.title: Data Engineer (Assistant System Engineer)
bullets: Built and optimized large-scale PySpark/Databricks ETL pipelines for customer transaction data, implementing column masking to support data-protection compliance at scale.
Owned the FastAPI data-access layer and optimized PostgreSQL queries using execution plans and CTEs, reducing query time by 30% and improving retrieval throughput by 40%.
Containerized and deployed the data service using Docker/Kubernetes, implementing zero-downtime rolling upgrades and reducing maintenance downtime by 80%.
Replaced ad-hoc SQL requests and manual data extracts with self-serve REST APIs, backed by database indexing and query optimization, reducing internal report load times and manual data-pull requests.

projects.name: GraphRAG & Multi-Source Retrieval Engine
projects.stack: Python · FastAPI · Qdrant · Neo4j · Groq Llama 3.3 70B / Llama 3.1 8B · Gemini embeddings · LangGraph · Docker
bullets: Engineered hybrid graph-vector retrieval system integrating Confluence, Notion, and Slack as a unified knowledge graph, Groq Llama 3.1 for ingest-time entity and relationship extraction to enable relationship-aware search.

Designed a multi-stage query pipeline spanning semantic caching, query rewriting, entity extraction, 2-hop graph traversal, hybrid search, cross-encoder reranking, and guardrails, feeding Groq Llama 3.3 70B for generation and improving context precision by ~20% over standalone vector search.
Added Redis/Qdrant-backed semantic caching with query rewriting, reducing average response latency by ~25%, and fully containerized the system with Docker Compose for production-style deployment.
